question: Bhimsen Joshi was one of the greatest Indian vocalists from ______, in the Hindustani classical tradition.
solution:
The correct answer is __Karnataka__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Bhimsen Gururaj Joshi

 
 
• He was an Indian Vocalist from **Karnataka**, in the Hindustani Classical tradition.
 
• He was well known for his renditions of devotional music.
 
• He belongs to the Kirana Gharana tradition of Hindustani Classical Music.
 
• He was awarded the highest civilian award of India's Bharat Ratna' in 2008
 
 
 
• Hindustani Classical Tradition is also Known as North Indian Classical Music or Shastriya Sangeet.
 
• The National anthem of India, Jana Gana Mana is classified as Hindustani Classical Music. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bhendi bazaar Gharana was founded around 1890 by brothers Chhajju Khan, Nazir Khan, and Khadim Hussain Khan in the Bhendi bazaar area of Mumbai.
 
• Agra Gharana represents a unique tradition of Hindustani Classical Music. Its compositions are known to be remarkable for their lyrical beauty and also for their musical potential.
 
• The bandishes of the Ragas are deeply influenced by the Braj culture, i.e. Lord Krishna and his enchanting levels, making it the most fascinating part of the Agra Gharana Gayaki.
 
• Patiala Gharana is one of the Gharanas in Indian Classical Music, which was founded by Ustad Fateh Ali Khan, and also Ustad Ali Baksh.
 
• Patiala Gharana has both kinds of singing – ‘Thumri’ and ‘Khyal’.
 
• The most famous exponents of Patiala Gharana are Pakistani ghazal singer Gulam Ali, and also the contemporary singer Shafqat Amanat Ali.
